claim: For the five-regular Clebsch graph, equivalently the folded five-cube on \(\mathbb F_2^4\) with edges for XOR differences \(1,2,4,8,15\), the ordinary independence complex has integral homotopy type \(\operatorname{Ind}(C)\simeq\bigvee^{9}S^3\). Its only nonzero reduced integral homology is \(\widetilde H_3\cong\mathbb Z^9\). An explicit acyclic matching of 191 nonempty-face pairs leaves one critical zero-cell and nine critical three-cells.
integrity: The exact Cayley and antipodal-quotient descriptions agree; all simplices and all directed Hasse relations are checked exhaustively by the bundled standard-library verifier. Only same-model review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: This is a complete integral homotopy calculation for the specific 5-regular Clebsch graph, not for its 10-regular complement or all folded cubes; no equivariant homotopy claim. Equivalent unindexed work cannot be ruled out.
title: The folded five-cube independence complex is a wedge of nine three-spheres
